blocks.text: Argentine Side of Iguazu Falls – Buenos Aires

provenance.rationale: The approved Word Day 10 heading provides Iguazu to Buenos Aires and its narrative identifies the Argentine Falls circuit; combined as a route label.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out to explore the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. The Ecological Jungle Train connects the main routes through the national park.

There are three walking options:

Lower Circuit: 1,700 m, approximately 1 hour 45 minutes, moderate difficulty.

Upper Circuit: 1,300 m, approximately 1 hour, easy difficulty.

Devil’s Throat: 1,000 m, approximately 1.5 hours, moderate difficulty.

The main waterfall has a drop of 82 m. After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires, which is paid separately. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved English Word Day 10 sections describe the train and three circuits but omit the precise walking times, difficulty levels and 82 m waterfall height supplied by current RU; separate domestic airfare is confirmed in Word exclusions.
